[[Category:Mermaid, sailed 6 Oct 1862]]
== Biography ==
Rose Ann was born about 1841, based on her age ten in the 1851 census. Later death and burial records imply about 1843–1844, but they are less contemporaneous. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-987|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[McCracken-5681|Mary Ann McCracken]]. In the 1851 census, Rose (age 10) was the daughter of Thomas Glasgow in Rasharkin.<ref>
'''1851 Census''':
"County Antrim, Ireland 1851 Census"<br/>
Original data: Masterson, Josephine. County Antrim, Ireland, 1851 Census (Fragments). Baltimore, MD, USA: Genealogical Publishing Co., 2000<br/>
{{Ancestry Sharing|37526761|7b22746f6b656e223a2268796739594d70455150377543563050647553707a4a45452b477a6b516236384c3236737a354d665537553d222c22746f6b656e5f76657273696f6e223a225632227d}} - {{Ancestry Record|49109|26524}} (accessed 12 May 2025)<br/>
Rose Ann Glasgow (10) daughter in household of Thomas Glasgow (35) in Rasharkin.
</ref>

in December of 1862 Rose and sister Eliza emigrated to New Zealand on the ''Mermaid'', arriving at Lyttelton, New \Zealand.<ref>''Mermaid'' Passenger List [https://freepages.rootsweb.com/~nzbound/genealogy/mermaid.htm]</ref>

Rose married John A Redpath in 1868 in New Zealand.<ref>
'''Marriage''':
"New Zealand, Marriage Index, 1840-1937"<br/>
Original data: New Zealand Marriage Index, 1840-1950. Microfiche<br/>
{{Ancestry Record|8950|791010}} (accessed 12 May 2025)<br/>
Rose Ann Glasgow marriage to John A Redpath in 1868 in New Zealand.
</ref>
in 1899 Rose was registered to vote in Linwood, Christchurch. <ref>
'''1899 Electoral Register''':
"New Zealand, Electoral Rolls, 1853-2010"<br/>
BAB Microfilming; Auckland, New Zealand; New Zealand Electoral Rolls, 1853-1981<br/>

Name: Rose Ann Redpath; Electoral Year: 1899; Residence Street Address: 50 East Belt; Residence Place: Linwood, New Zealand; District: Christchurch; Region or Province: Canterbury.
</ref>

Rose died on 8 July 1921 in Christchurch, Canterbury, New Zealand and was buried at Bromley Cemetery, Bromley, Christchurch City, Canterbury, New Zealand.<ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-987]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The 1851 household identifies Rose Ann, aged ten, as Thomas and Mary Ann McCracken’s daughter. The family combination and age fit the selected Thomas household.

Confident for the census child’s paternity; later records suggesting c 1843–44 birth are a separate date/adult-identity question.

Next useful test: Compare the original household and later marriage ages if the date conflict matters.

Source basis already held: [http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1851/Antrim/Kilconway/Rasharkin/Lisnagaver/37/ http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1851/Antrim/Kilconway/Rasharkin/Lisnagaver/37/]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
